author: visegrad24
text:
Mbappé just gave an interview on why he refused to wear the Ceuta solidarity before yesterday’s La Liga match:

“It was the club’s decision. The players were supposed to wear it.

The first thing I want to say is that I stand in complete solidarity with Ceuta and with all the victims. 

Because before being a footballer, I’m a human being but I also wanted to make a gesture and spare a thought for all the immigrants who have lost their lives and who are also living in very difficult conditions.

It wasn’t an easy position to be in. It was difficult, because people might think that I’m against the people of Ceuta, but no, absolutely not. I have nothing against them and they have 100% of my support and thoughts.

But I also wanted to spare a thought for everyone who is suffering, because at the end of the day, I’m human and I don’t want to prioritize one person’s suffering over another.

There are people suffering, and it makes me very sad to see that in the world. I’m someone who wants the best for the world we live in.

I want to send a message of positivity and peace, and I hope this situation is resolved quickly”

Mr Mbappé, the situarion will be resolved when all illegal migrants are deported from Ceuta and Europe along with millions of criminal migrants, Islamist migrants and non-contributing migrants who refuse to get a job and get off welfare either out of laziness or contempt for European tax payers.
